keys: Kumpulkan koin di jalan untuk belanja.
en: Collect coins on the road to go shopping.

keys: Koin belum cukup. Butuh %d koin lagi.
en: Not enough coins. You need %d more.

keys: Gerak: WASD / panah / swipe   Pause: Esc / P
en: Move: WASD / arrows / swipe   Pause: Esc / P

keys: Hujan deras: jarak pandang terbatas dan aspal licin.
en: Heavy rain: limited visibility and slippery asphalt.

keys: Kucing jalanan suka menghalangi jalan. Cari jalur lain!
en: Street cats like to block the way. Find another path!
Coin bonus (%d, already in your wallet)

keys: Kamu sudah sampai di Pos. Ambil paket pengganti dan lanjutkan perjalanan?
en: You reached a checkpoint. Take a replacement package and keep going?

keys: Pengiriman gagal. Upah hari ini hangus untuk ganti rugi.
en: Delivery failed. Today's pay goes to compensation.

keys: Paket agak penyok, tapi masih aman.
en: The package is a bit dented, but still fine.

keys: Paketnya sampai dengan baik, cuma agak lama.
en: It arrived in good shape, just a little slow.
I'll be speaking to your manager.

keys: Tekan W / panah atas (atau tap layar) untuk maju. Hindari kendaraan!
en: Press W / up arrow (or tap the screen) to move forward. Avoid the traffic!

keys: Aduh! Tiap tabrakan merusak paket. Kalau ikon paket di kiri atas habis, pengiriman gagal.
en: Ouch! Every crash damages the package. If the package icons at the top left run out, the delivery fails.

keys: Ambil koin! +Rp1.000 untuk upah, dan masuk dompet untuk belanja di Toko Masbro.
en: Grab coins! +Rp1,000 pay each, and they go to your wallet for Masbro's Shop.

keys: Power-up! Helm menahan 1 benturan, sepatu bikin langkah lebih cepat.
en: Power-up! A helmet blocks 1 hit, shoes make you step faster.

keys: Ada lubang di aspal. Terperosok bikin paket rusak, jadi lewati saja.
en: A pothole ahead. Falling in damages the package, so go around it.

keys: Sungai! Lompat ke atas rakit dan ikut arusnya. Jangan sampai tercebur.
en: A river! Hop onto a raft and ride the current. Don't fall in.

keys: Ini Pos. Kalau paket hancur setelah ini, kamu bisa lanjut dari sini.
en: This is a checkpoint. If the package breaks after this, you can continue from here.

keys: ETA hampir habis! Terlambat membuat upah dipotong per detik.
en: The ETA is almost up! Being late cuts your pay every second.

keys: Kucing dan pejalan kaki tidak merusak paket, tapi menghalangi. Cari jalur lain.
en: Cats and pedestrians don't damage the package, but they block you. Find another path.
Stories unlock once you play through them.
Lighting effects (turn off if your phone is slow)
You haven't picked up the package!
Lucky you weren't carrying the package!

keys: Ambil paket dulu di kios penjemputan (ikon paket melayang), baru antar ke rumah pelanggan di ujung atas.
en: Pick up the package at the sender's stall first (look for the floating package), then deliver it to the customer's house at the top.
Careful, don't let it get scratched!

keys: Sini, Mas! Jangan sampai lecet ya!
en: Over here! Don't let it get scratched!
Hot meatballs, sir! Come on over!

keys: Kota Ngacir, kota yang tidak pernah berhenti ngebut. Di tengahnya ada Kedai Chill: kedai minum dan kolam air hangat milik Masbro, tempat warga kota melepas penat.
en: Ngacir City, a city that never stops speeding. In the middle of it sits Kedai Chill: Masbro's drink stall and warm pool, where the city's residents come to unwind.

keys: Air hangat, jeruk dingin, hidup tenang.
en: Warm water, cold oranges, a calm life.

keys: Sore itu pintu kedai digedor. Pemilik Lahan datang membawa Surat Peringatan Ketiga.
en: That afternoon someone pounded on the door. The landlord had come with a Third Warning Letter.

keys: Sewa kedai ini nunggak tiga bulan. Totalnya {target}. Lima hari lagi belum lunas, tempat ini saya kosongkan.
en: The rent on this place is three months overdue. That's {target} in total. If it isn't paid in five days, I'm clearing this place out.
Five days...? Can I pay in installments?

keys: Boleh. Asal lunas dalam lima hari.
en: You can. As long as it's all paid in five days.

keys: Kerja yang dibayar harian cuma satu: kurir masa percobaan Ngacir Express. Masbro memasang jeruk di kepala, lalu mendaftar.
en: Only one job pays daily: a probationary courier at Ngacir Express. Masbro balanced an orange on his head and signed up.

keys: Saya Bos Koko, kepala kurir. Moto kita: Kalo gak kilat, gak selamat!
en: I'm Boss Koko, head of couriers. Our motto: If it ain't lightning, it ain't landing!

keys: Kurir kita jalan kaki. Kota semacet ini, yang berani nyeberang yang sampai duluan. Telat, upah dipotong. Paket rusak, ganti rugi!
en: Our couriers go on foot. In traffic this bad, whoever dares to cross gets there first. Late? Your pay gets cut. Damaged package? You pay for it!

keys: Kurir baru? Kapibara? Jalanan kota cuma muat buat yang gesit. Mending balik berendam sana.
en: A new courier? A capybara? These streets are only for the quick. Better go back to your bath.

keys: Santai. Cepat boleh, asal paketnya selamat.
en: Relax. Fast is fine, as long as the package arrives safe.

keys:
Kejar Timer ETA. Jaga paket dari benturan. Kumpulkan upah untuk melunasi sewa Kedai Chill.

Trobos Ajalah!
en:
Beat the ETA timer. Protect the package from bumps. Save your wages to pay Kedai Chill's rent.

Trobos Ajalah!

keys: Lama banget sih! Untung gorengannya masih garing. Lecet dikit aja, udah saya kasih bintang satu plus ulasan dua paragraf!
en: You took forever! Lucky the fritters are still crispy. One scratch and I'd have given you one star plus a two-paragraph review!

keys: Sama-sama, Kak. Selamat makan, jangan lupa napas pas ngunyah.
en: You're welcome. Enjoy, and remember to breathe while you chew.

keys: Malamnya di Kedai Chill. Tabungan sewa: {saved} dari {target}.
en: That night at Kedai Chill. Rent savings: {saved} of {target}.

keys: Lumayan buat kapibara lamban! Besok kamu bawa kue ulang tahun tiga tingkat plus akuarium cupang. Pecah sedikit, upah dipotong!
en: Not bad for a slow capybara! Tomorrow you're carrying a three-tier birthday cake plus a betta fish tank. One crack and your pay gets cut!

keys: Gorengannya remuk begini? Untung masih bisa dimakan. Awas aja besok-besok!
en: The fritters are crushed! Lucky they're still edible. Watch it next time!
Sorry. I'll be more careful tomorrow.

keys: Hari pertama sudah kena denda! Besok kue ulang tahun dan akuarium cupang. Kalau itu pecah, upahmu habis!
en: Fined on your first day! Tomorrow it's a birthday cake and a betta fish tank. Break those and your pay is gone!
Got it, Boss. Slow... but sure.

keys: Hari kedua! Kue ulang tahun tiga tingkat plus akuarium cupang untuk cucu Bu Sri. Dua-duanya rapuh, akuariumnya berat.
en: Day two! A three-tier birthday cake plus a betta fish tank for Mrs. Sri's grandchild. Both are fragile, and the tank is heavy.

keys: Yo, kapibara! Bawa akuarium jalan kaki? Hari ini aku lewat rute yang sama. Jangan nangis kalau kesalip!
en: Yo, capybara! Carrying a fish tank on foot? I'm on the same route today. Don't cry when I pass you!

keys: Bawa kue itu mirip bawa ketenangan jiwa, Kuro. Pelan tapi pasti.
en: Carrying a cake is like carrying inner peace, Kuro. Slow but sure.

keys: Gak ada pelan-pelan! Cepat tapi utuh! Awas kulit pisang, Kuro suka buang sampah dari motornya.
en: No slow and sure here! Fast and intact! And watch for banana peels, Kuro likes to toss trash off his bike.

keys: Akuariumnya berat, langkah Masbro jadi lebih lambat. Rute hari ini juga melewati sungai. Atur waktu menyeberang!
en: The tank is heavy, so Masbro walks slower. Today's route crosses a river too. Time your crossings!

keys: Kuenya masih berdiri tegak, cupangnya masih berenang. Cucu Bu Sri meniup lilin sambil tertawa.
en: The cake is still standing tall and the betta is still swimming. Mrs. Sri's grandchild blew out the candles, laughing.

keys: Kuncinya satu: pasrah, tapi tetap ngerem.
en: There's only one secret: go with the flow, but keep braking.

keys: Kabar buruk, Masbro! Besok jalan utama ditutup galian pipa. Semua kurir harus lewat gang sempit. Semoga badan gembulmu muat!
en: Bad news, Masbro! Tomorrow the main road is closed for pipe works. Every courier has to use the narrow alleys. Hope your chubby body fits!

keys: Kuenya miring dan air akuariumnya tumpah separuh. Untung cupangnya masih hidup.
en: The cake is leaning and half the tank's water spilled. Luckily the betta is still alive.

keys: Upah hari ini kepotong denda lagi...
en: Today's pay got cut by fines again...

keys: Darurat! Jalan utama dibongkar galian pipa. Hari ini kamu antar es krim lewat Gang Tiga ke rumah Pak Budi.
en: Emergency! The main road is torn up for pipe works. Today you're taking ice cream through Alley Three to Mr. Budi's house.

keys: Es krim... siang bolong... lewat gang?
en: Ice cream... at high noon... through the alleys?

keys: Makanya cepat! Telat sedikit, es krimnya cair. Satu lagi: di gang ada Pak Buldog, satpam komplek. Dia benci yang lari-lari.
en: So hurry! A little late and it melts. One more thing: Mr. Bulldog guards that neighborhood. He hates anyone running around.

keys: GUK! GUK! Di komplek ini jalan pelan! Yang lari-lari saya kejar!
en: WOOF! WOOF! Walk slowly in this neighborhood! Anyone running gets chased!

keys: Kalau Pak Buldog menggonggong, Masbro panik dan ngacir: langkahnya lebih cepat, tapi gampang tergelincir. Awas juga lubang galian di aspal!
en: When Mr. Bulldog barks, Masbro panics and bolts: his steps get faster, but he slips easily. And watch out for the dug-up holes in the road!

keys: Es krimnya masih beku. Pak Budi heran melihat kurir datang sambil diiringi gonggongan.
en: The ice cream was still frozen. Mr. Budi was puzzled to see a courier arrive with barking right behind him.

keys: Tadi ada dorongan semangat ekstra dari Pak Buldog.
en: I had some extra motivation from Mr. Bulldog.

keys: Dengar petir itu? Besok badai, dan pesanan VIP Nana sudah menunggu. Gagal besok, sewa Kedai Chill makin jauh dari lunas!
en: Hear that thunder? There's a storm tomorrow, and Nana's VIP order is waiting. Fail tomorrow and Kedai Chill's rent drifts even further away!

keys: Badai, ya... jeruknya harus diikat lebih kencang.
en: A storm, huh... I'd better tie this orange on tighter.

keys: Es krimnya sudah mulai cair. Pak Budi menghela napas, tapi tetap menerimanya.
en: The ice cream had started to melt. Mr. Budi sighed, but he took it anyway.

keys: Pak Buldog terlalu bersemangat hari ini...
en: Mr. Bulldog was a little too enthusiastic today...

keys: Hari keempat. Badai turun tepat di jam sibuk, genangan di mana-mana.
en: Day four. A storm hits right at rush hour, with puddles everywhere.

keys: Gak ada waktu buat neduh! Laptop VIP punya Nana harus sampai kering. Pakai jas hujanmu, ngacir sekarang!
en: No time to take shelter! Nana's VIP laptop has to arrive dry. Put on your raincoat and go!

keys: Hujan, ya... padahal enak banget berendam air hangat sekarang.
en: Rain, huh... a warm soak would be perfect right now.

keys: Laptop saya harus sampai sebelum rapat! Telat satu detik, bintang satu!
en: My laptop has to arrive before my meeting! One second late and it's one star!

keys: Jarak pandang pendek dan aspal licin. Jangan sampai laptopnya tercebur!
en: Visibility is short and the road is slippery. Don't let the laptop fall in the water!

keys: B-badai begini laptopnya masih kering? Oke... kamu kurir pertama yang bikin saya terkesan.
en: In a st-storm like this, and the laptop's still dry? Okay... you're the first courier who's ever impressed me.

keys: Yang basah cuma celana. Yang penting reputasi aman.
en: Only my pants got wet. My reputation stayed dry.

keys: Besok ujian akhirmu: Patung Kristal Jeruk milik Pak Wali Kota. Antar dengan selamat, dan kamu lulus.
en: Tomorrow is your final test: the Mayor's Crystal Orange Statue. Deliver it safely and you pass.

keys: Kristal... jeruk. Akhirnya ada paket yang sejalan dengan jiwaku.
en: A crystal... orange. Finally, a package that speaks to my soul.

keys: Laptopnya lembap! Kalau sampai rusak, ulasan saya tiga paragraf!
en: The laptop is damp! If it's broken, my review will be three paragraphs!

keys: Hari penentuan! Patung Kristal Jeruk untuk Pak Wali Kota, antar ke Balai Kota. Satu goresan pun dihitung.
en: Judgment day! The Crystal Orange Statue for the Mayor, delivered to City Hall. Every scratch counts.

keys: Bonus Wali Kota itu punyaku, Masbro! Hari ini aku ngebut habis-habisan.
en: That Mayor's bonus is mine, Masbro! Today I'm going full throttle.

keys: Maaf, Kuro. Sewa Kedai Chill harus lunas. Hari ini aku gak bisa santai.
en: Sorry, Kuro. Kedai Chill's rent has to be paid. Today I can't take it easy.

keys: Itu semangat yang saya cari! NGACIR!
en: That's the spirit I've been looking for! NGACIR!

keys: Rute terpanjang: galian, Pak Buldog, Kuro, dan sisa hujan. Pak Wali Kota teliti: denda kerusakan 2x.
en: The longest route yet: road works, Mr. Bulldog, Kuro, and leftover rain. The Mayor is meticulous: damage fines are doubled.

keys: Patung kristal saya sampai dengan selamat! Terima kasih, Kurir Kapibara.
en: My crystal statue arrived safely! Thank you, Capybara Courier.

keys: SQUAWK! Selamat, Masbro. Mulai besok kamu kurir tetap Ngacir Express!
en: SQUAWK! Congratulations, Masbro. Starting tomorrow you're a permanent Ngacir Express courier!

keys: Hmph. Kali ini kamu menang. ...Kedai Chill-mu masih buka, kan? Aku boleh mampir?
en: Hmph. You win this time. ...Your Kedai Chill is still open, right? Can I drop by?
Savings of {saved} are enough to pay the {target} rent.

keys: Lunas. Kedai Chill boleh tetap buka.
en: Paid in full. Kedai Chill can stay open.
The kedai is safe. Time to get back in the pool.

keys: Kedai Chill selamat, dan kini jadi tempat istirahat para kurir kota. Trobos Ajalah, Masbro!
en: Kedai Chill is saved, and it's now where the city's couriers come to rest. Trobos Ajalah, Masbro!

keys: Masa percobaan selesai. Tabungan {saved}, belum cukup untuk sewa {target}.
en: The probation is over. Savings: {saved}, not enough for the {target} rent.

keys: Upahmu belum cukup. Tapi saya catat: kamu tidak pernah ugal-ugalan.
en: Your pay isn't enough. But I noted that you were never reckless.

keys: Kedai Chill saya segel dulu. Lunasi sisanya, kuncinya saya kembalikan.
en: I'm sealing Kedai Chill for now. Pay the rest and you'll get the keys back.

keys: Belum selesai. Besok aku antar paket lagi.
en: It's not over. Tomorrow I'll deliver again.

keys: Sebelumnya… Pemilik Lahan menagih tunggakan sewa Kedai Chill sebesar {target}. Masbro mendaftar jadi kurir masa percobaan di Ngacir Express.
en: Previously… The landlord demanded {target} in overdue rent for Kedai Chill. Masbro signed up as a probationary courier at Ngacir Express.

keys: Sebelumnya… Gorengan Nana sudah terantar. Kuro, kurir rival dari CepatKilat, mulai mengincar rute Masbro.
en: Previously… Nana's fritters were delivered. Kuro, the rival courier from CepatKilat, started eyeing Masbro's routes.

keys: Sebelumnya… Jalan utama ditutup galian pipa. Hari ini Masbro harus lewat Gang Tiga, wilayah Pak Buldog.
en: Previously… The main road was closed for pipe works. Today Masbro has to go through Alley Three, Mr. Bulldog's turf.

keys: Sebelumnya… Es krim Pak Budi sudah lewat. Hari ini badai turun, dan Nana menunggu laptop VIP-nya.
en: Previously… Mr. Budi's ice cream made it. Today a storm rolls in, and Nana is waiting for her VIP laptop.

keys: Sebelumnya… Tinggal satu hari. Patung Kristal Jeruk Pak Wali Kota menentukan lolos atau tidaknya masa percobaan.
en: Previously… One day left. The Mayor's Crystal Orange Statue decides whether Masbro passes probation.

keys: Tabungan sewa Kedai Chill: {saved} dari {target}. Sudah cukup, tinggal lolos masa percobaan!
en: Kedai Chill rent savings: {saved} of {target}. That's enough, now just pass the probation!

keys: Tabungan sewa Kedai Chill: {saved} dari {target}. Kurang {left} lagi.
en: Kedai Chill rent savings: {saved} of {target}. {left} to go.

keys: Patung Kristal Jeruk sampai di Balai Kota. Masbro resmi diangkat menjadi kurir tetap Ngacir Express, dan sewa Kedai Chill lunas. Trobos Ajalah!
en: The Crystal Orange Statue reached City Hall. Masbro is officially a permanent Ngacir Express courier, and Kedai Chill's rent is paid. Trobos Ajalah!

keys: Tabungan masih kurang %s. Pemilik Lahan masih memberi waktu: ulangi hari mana pun untuk memperbaiki upah. Upah terbaik tiap hari yang dihitung.
en: Savings are still %s short. The landlord is giving you more time: replay any day to improve your pay. Your best pay for each day counts.

keys: Shift Malam: Kedai Chill tetap butuh biaya operasional. Main lagi hari mana pun untuk mengumpulkan koin; upah terbaik tiap hari tetap tersimpan.
en: Night Shift: Kedai Chill still has running costs. Replay any day to collect coins; your best pay for each day is kept.

keys: Masa percobaan berakhir, tapi tabungan Masbro belum cukup untuk sewa Kedai Chill. Kedai disegel sampai sisa sewanya lunas.
en: The probation is over, but Masbro's savings aren't enough for Kedai Chill's rent. The kedai is sealed until the rest is paid.

keys: %s teliti: denda kerusakan 2x. Paket sempurna dan tepat waktu dapat tip %s.
en: %s is meticulous: damage fines 2x. A perfect, on-time package earns a %s tip.

keys: %s tidak sabaran: potongan telat 2x. Paket sempurna dan tepat waktu dapat tip %s.
en: %s is impatient: late cuts 2x. A perfect, on-time package earns a %s tip.

keys: Kuro, kurir rival, suka ngebut tiba-tiba dan membuang kulit pisang. Hati-hati!
en: Kuro, the rival courier, speeds by out of nowhere and throws banana peels. Careful!

keys: Kuro, kurir rival, suka ngebut tiba-tiba. Hati-hati!
en: Kuro, the rival courier, speeds by out of nowhere. Careful!

keys: Pak Buldog menjaga komplek. Lewat dekat dia, Masbro panik dan gampang tergelincir!
en: Mr. Bulldog guards the neighborhood. Pass close to him and Masbro panics and slips easily!

keys: Mukanya santai, tapi paketnya mulus tanpa lecet. Mantap!

en: Be more careful next time, Masbro.

keys: Paketnya agak hancur, tapi isinya masih bisa dipakai.
en: The package is a bit wrecked, but what's inside still works.

keys: Ini paket atau hasil bongkar muatan kapal karam?!
en: Is this a package or cargo from a shipwreck?!

keys: ASTAGA, MASBRO! Itu barang kiriman, bukan onde-onde yang boleh diremukin!
en: GOOD GRIEF, MASBRO! That's a delivery, not a sesame ball you can squash!

keys: Sempurna. Ini layak dipajang di Balai Kota.
en: Perfect. This deserves a place in City Hall.
Intact, but the ceremony is about to start.
There's a scratch. I'm noting it.

keys: Ini jauh dari standar Balai Kota, Masbro.
en: This is far below City Hall standards, Masbro.

keys: T-tepat waktu? Gak lecet sedikit pun? Oke... bintang lima terpaksa saya kasih!
en: O-on time? Not a single scratch? Fine... I guess you get five stars!

keys: Lumayan. Tapi detiknya tetap saya hitung, ya.
en: Not bad. But I'm still counting the seconds.
Slow! I'm putting that in my review.

keys: Bintang satu! Plus ulasan dua paragraf!
en: One star! Plus a two-paragraph review!

keys: WOI MASBRO! Isinya remuk tuh! Pelan-pelan dikit!
en: HEY MASBRO! It's getting crushed! Ease up a little!
Time's running out, Masbro! No daydreaming!

keys: Tuh dia datang! Awas aja kalau lecet!
en: There he is! It better not be scratched!

keys: Itu Kuro, kurir rival! Dia ngebut, jangan berdiri di lane-nya.
en: That's Kuro, the rival courier! He's fast, don't stand in his lane.

keys: Kulit pisang dari Kuro! Menginjaknya bikin Masbro tergelincir satu petak.
en: A banana peel from Kuro! Stepping on it makes Masbro slide one tile.

keys: Pak Buldog menggonggong! Masbro panik: langkah lebih cepat, tapi gampang tergelincir di aspal.
en: Mr. Bulldog is barking! Masbro panics: faster steps, but he slips easily on asphalt.

keys: Gorengan saya harus masih garing! Saya hitung dari sekarang.
en: My fritters better still be crispy! I'm timing you from now.

keys: Mana gorengan saya?! Bintang satu sudah menanti!
en: Where are my fritters?! A one-star review is waiting!

keys: Masih panas, Mas! Cepat sebelum melempem.
en: Still hot! Hurry before they go soggy.

keys: Kuenya buat ulang tahun cucu saya. Hati-hati, ya!
en: The cake is for my grandchild's birthday. Be careful!
All the guests are already here...

keys: Kue sama akuarium cupangnya satu paket. Dua-duanya rapuh!
en: The cake and the betta tank are one package. Both are fragile!

keys: Es krimnya buat anak-anak. Jangan sampai cair!
en: The ice cream is for the kids. Don't let it melt!
The ice cream is about to melt...

keys: Laptop saya buat rapat! Awas kalau basah!
en: My laptop is for a meeting! It better not get wet!
I'm late for my meeting because of you!

keys: Laptopnya sudah dibungkus plastik. Tetap jangan tercebur!
en: The laptop is wrapped in plastic. Still, don't fall in the water!

keys: Patungnya untuk upacara hari ini. Saya tunggu di Balai Kota.
en: The statue is for today's ceremony. I'll be waiting at City Hall.
The ceremony is about to start...
The guests are already waiting, Masbro.

keys: Ini satu-satunya di dunia. Jangan sampai tergores!
en: It's one of a kind. Don't let it get scratched!

keys: Pesanan Nana. Kuat dibenturkan, tapi harus sampai sebelum dingin dan melempem.
en: Nana's order. They can take a few bumps, but they have to arrive before they go cold and soggy.

keys: Kue tiga tingkat plus akuarium berisi air. Berat: langkah Masbro jadi lebih lambat.
en: A three-tier cake plus a tank full of water. Heavy: Masbro walks slower.

keys: Cepat cair. Target waktu paling ketat; telat sedikit, potongannya lebih besar.
en: Melts fast. The tightest time target; a little late means a bigger pay cut.

keys: Laptop Nana untuk rapat. Jangan sampai basah, apalagi tercebur.
en: Nana's laptop for her meeting. Don't let it get wet, let alone fall in the water.

keys: Pesanan Pak Wali Kota. Sangat rapuh: dua benturan dan patungnya pecah.
en: The Mayor's order. Very fragile: two bumps and it shatters.
